author: Li Zhengyu
asr_identification: Suoyang cheng 鎖陽城, Guazhou county
evidence: Taken as the starting point; Guazhou → Changle city 115 li.
quote: 从瓜州（今甘肃省瓜州县锁阳城）到伊吾（今新疆哈密市）

author: Li Zhengyu
asr_identification: the Huangshui gou 黃水溝 (lower course Lucao gou 芦草沟) by the Maquan small city, not the Shule
evidence: Read with his location of the pass at the Maquan small city; the crossing c. 10 li upstream, E of Maquan and 2 li W of Qiaozi village, then N through the Qiaozi gap in the Shigong shan.
quote: 胡卢河为今之黄水沟（下游名芦草沟）

author: Li Zhengyu
asr_identification: the small city NW of Maquan village, NE of Suoyang cheng township
evidence: His earlier view (1997, 2010) restated; the crossing 10 li upstream E of it.
quote: 余考唐代玉门关为今瓜州县锁阳城镇东北马圈村小城
note: one of the three open proposals

author: Li Zhengyu
asr_identification: the Xinjing post site 31 huali (27 li 200 bu) N of Liugong poch'eng (Tang Changle city), 4.5 huali N of the Shule
evidence: Field survey: fort walls and an Eastern Han beacon 8 m high, rubbish and sherds; first post of the Moheyan road, first beacon going north; earlier (2009 book p. 85) he had put it at Shajingzi. From the Shigong shan the first beacon is 40 km straight, '80 li' by the winding road.
quote: 改定在六工破城子（唐常乐县城）北31华里（廿七唐里二百步）古驿戍处
note: one stage S of Stein's Pei-tan-tzu; matches P.2005's own distances (route/README §11)

author: Li Zhengyu
name_in_asr: 第二烽 廣顯驛, 第三烽 烏山驛
asr_identification: Guangxian = Baidunzi 白墩子 (Han–Qing beacon, fort, springs); Wushan = Hongliuyuan 紅柳園 (beacon, spring, post ruin with Han slips and Kaiyuan tongbao)
evidence: Field surveys along the post road; distances 50 and 74 Tang li by his reckoning.
quote: 据其所在位置及与南北二驿相距里数（西北距乌山驿七十四唐里，南距新井驿五十唐里），可断白墩子必即广显驿
note: Stein's first and second stages are Li's second and third beacons

author: Li Zhengyu
asr_identification: Daquan 大泉, 35 km NW of Hongliuyuan: post and fort ruins, hemp sandals, bronze arrowheads, Kaiyuan tongbao, a beacon base, two springs (the 'double spring')
evidence: Field survey; the Qing Daquan station; 69 Tang li from Wushan, 64 to the Fifth post.
page: web text, n. [9] and p. on the route
quote: 考第四烽即今之大泉（后为双泉驿）
note: Stein's third stage; Stein's fourth (Malianjing) is Li's fifth

author: Li Zhengyu
name_in_asr: 第五烽 = 第五驛; 莫賀延磧
asr_identification: the fifth beacon = the Fifth post at Malianjing (Eastern Han coins at the post ruin); the Moheyan = the gobi from Malianjing north to the Karlik range; the five beacons guarded the Tang side of the pre-630 border at the Xingxingxia hills
evidence: The road named the Fifth Road after its foremost beacon; after 630 five more beacons W of it, ten posts set in 696.
page: web text, n. [11] and pp. on the Moheyan road
quote: 莫贺延碛，为今瓜州县马莲井以北至哈密北山（古亦名祁连山、今名哈尔里克山）以南的大漠戈壁
note: Xingxingxia (Stein's fifth beacon) is Lengquan post

author: Li Zhengyu
asr_identification: Lucaojingzi 芦草井子 in the Zhaobi shan, 49 km W(NW) of Daquan on the 1:50,000 map; seeping springs and reed beds
evidence: Field visit with Guazhou county officials; the name fits wild horses' grazing on reeds; Xuanzang, lost in a sandstorm, passed it to the south.
quote: 因疑此即所谓“野马泉”是也
note: differs from Stein's map estimate (a water stage on the Dunhuang–Hami track)

author: Li Zhengyu
asr_identification: Dashui 大水 in the north of Dunhuang, 336 Tang li N of Dunhuang on the Shuogan road (a post from 692; Han beacon; wetlands until the 1960s), about 330 li and 3 days from Yiwu
evidence: Rejects Stein's Kushui–Changliushui: no water there, and too near Yiwu for the Xingzhuang's three days.
quote: 笔者推测玄奘所到水泉青草处，疑乎在此

author: Li Zhengyu
asr_identification: Hami; Xuanzang left Guazhou on the 1st of the 8th month of Zhenguan 3 (24 Aug 629) and reached Yiwu on the 16th
evidence: Day-by-day itinerary from the Life and the Xingzhuang; 900 Tang li Guazhou → Yizhou, about 100 li a day on the travelling days.
quote: 八月初一始自瓜州起身往伊吾国。…至八月十六日终抵伊吾
